findings.title: Page marked as client component without needing it
findings.explanation: The page only renders static data and a child component; it uses no state, effects, handlers or browser APIs, so the directive moves the whole page to the client bundle.

findings.title: Server secret read in a client component
findings.explanation: The file is a client module and reads a non-`NEXT_PUBLIC_` environment variable as a payment credential. It is undefined in the browser, so the request is unauthenticated, and the design pushes a secret toward the client.
findings.suggested_fix: Perform the charge in a Server Action or Route Handler and call that from the client.

findings.title: Large hero image uses a plain
findings.explanation: A 4000x2500 image is rendered at the top of the page with a plain ``, which skips resizing, modern formats and lazy/priority handling.
findings.suggested_fix: Use `next/image` with explicit dimensions and `priority` for the hero.

limitations: Expected result for the evaluation harness; labelled by the maintainers.
